name: Cloak of Arachnida
summary: A cloak that grants Poison Resistance, spider climbing, web walking, and a daily Web.

stats.effect:
This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint, silvery threads. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits.

***Poison Resistance.*** You have {ref:glossary/resistance} to Poison damage.

***Spider Climb.*** You have a {ref:glossary/climb-speed} equal to your {ref:glossary/speed} and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

***Spider Walk.*** You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were {ref:glossary/difficult-terrain}.

***Web.*** You can cast *{ref:spell/web}* (save DC 13). The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
